02 / FIVE STEPS. A CHECKED OUTCOME.

Don’t stop at “fixed.”
Check that it works.

01

Investigate

Match the records. Let Prism challenge the proposal and resolve objections before rehearsal.

02

Rehearse

Try the proposed access grant on a copy. Review exactly what would change.

03

Approve

You approve one specific plan. Changed evidence requires a new preview.

04

Repair

Grant the purchased access once. Leave the original payment alone.

05

Verify

Read the payment and access record again, then check the purchased resource.

03 / YOUR SECOND PAIR OF EYES

Personable teammates.
Specific responsibilities.

A little personality makes the details easier to follow. Source records and explicit checks support the decision.

Fictional AI characters. Public-demo consultations are scripted; the optional backend uses a bounded, evidence-linked challenge round.

04 / FROM DEMO TO INTEGRATION

Digital access.
One clear outcome.

The product starts with one question: did the customer get the access they paid for? This working demo follows a course purchase from missing access to a reviewed, approved correction and a checked outcome. Membership and download recovery are future directions to validate.
